title: Gatefold analysis result
description: Machine-readable claim collection emitted by gatefold --format json. Version 1.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this result schema. Additive changes keep the version; structural changes bump it.

claim.description: A single descriptive statement about the input representation. Never a judgement of quality.

ruleId.description: Stable identifier of the rule that produced this claim (e.g. 'element-counts'). Lets consumers select claims without parsing claim text. Optional so results written before ruleId existed remain valid; Gatefold always emits it.

evidence.description: References into the input export that support the claim. A claim without evidence is invalid.

confidence.description: Certainty that the evidence supports the claim. 1 = fully supported. Not a harness quality score.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the input export document. The empty string references the whole document.

elementId.description: Identifier of the referenced element inside the export, when the export defines element ids.

note.description: Optional human-readable clarification of what the reference shows.

sourceFile.description: Path of the input export file the claim was derived from.

exportVersion.description: Version of the input export (e.g. the pflVersion field of a pfl --json document), when the export carries one.

transform.description: Names of the transformations applied between the raw input and this claim, in application order. Empty when the claim reads the input directly.

classifierVersion.description: Version of the export's interpretation classifier, when the export carries one.

interpretationOrigin.description: How the export's interpretation was produced (e.g. 'stored' or 'recomputed' for a pfl document), when the export carries one.

observedSnapshotId.description: Identifier of the snapshot the export observed, when the export carries one.

resolvedSnapshotId.description: Identifier of the snapshot the export resolved, when the export carries one.

runtimeName.description: Display name of the runtime the export describes, when the export carries one.
